title: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he used Claude to prove the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis and posts the proof in the Lean programming language (Joseph Howlett/Scientific American)
summary: Joseph Howlett / Scientific American: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he used Claude to prove the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis and posts the proof in the Lean programming language — An AI-generated solution of the 167-year-old problem, long considered far out of reach to human mathematicians …
